environment.description: ECS Fargate service in isolated VPC (us-west-2). Network Load Balancer with TLS listener on port 443 configured with mutual TLS authentication. NLB TLS policy uses custom trust store (arn:aws:acm-pca:us-west-2:ACCOUNT:certificate-authority/ca-id) requiring client certificates signed by internal PKI CA. The NLB listener's TLS negotiation terminates connections that do not present a valid client certificate from the trust anchor before any TCP connection is forwarded to the target group. Target group uses TLS on port 8080 with proxy protocol v2 carrying the client cert DN. Security group on ENI restricts inbound to NLB subnet CIDR only (10.0.48.0/20). Additionally, VPC endpoint policy on the interface endpoint restricts source to known service mesh sidecar identity. Task networking mode is awsvpc with no public IP assignment.
